name: Sticky Navigation
outcome: Fixed nav should not obscure content
recommendation: Add padding-top to body equal to nav height
avoid: Let nav overlap first section content

name: Back Button
outcome: Users expect back to work predictably
recommendation: Preserve navigation history properly

name: Deep Linking
outcome: URLs should reflect current state for sharing
recommendation: Update URL on state/view changes

name: Overflow Hidden
outcome: Hidden overflow can clip important content
recommendation: Test all content fits within containers

name: Fixed Positioning
outcome: Fixed elements can overlap or be inaccessible
recommendation: Account for safe areas and other fixed elements

name: Stacking Context
outcome: New stacking contexts reset z-index
recommendation: Understand what creates new stacking context
avoid: Expect z-index to work across contexts

name: Content Jumping
outcome: Images badges validation text and skeleton replacements can shift nearby content when they update
recommendation: Reserve appropriate space or keep async states in a stable content-driven container
avoid: Insert compact text or media without a layout strategy

name: Focus States
outcome: Keyboard focus, including controls inside a modal, needs a visible indicator
recommendation: Use a visible focus ring on every interactive control, including modal controls

name: Loading Buttons
outcome: Prevent double submission during async actions
recommendation: Disable button and show loading state

name: Input Labels
outcome: Every input needs a visible label
recommendation: Always show label above or beside input

name: Error Placement
outcome: Each invalid field needs an inline error connected to that field
recommendation: Show a specific error below the input and reference it with aria-describedby
avoid: Show only a top-level error without identifying each invalid field

name: Input Types
outcome: Use appropriate input types
recommendation: Use email tel number url etc

name: Autofill Support
outcome: Help browsers autofill correctly
recommendation: Use autocomplete attribute properly

name: Required Indicators
outcome: Mark required fields clearly
recommendation: Use asterisk or (required) text

name: Password Visibility
outcome: Let users see password while typing
recommendation: Toggle to show/hide password

name: Submit Feedback
outcome: Confirm form submission status
recommendation: Show loading then success/error state

name: Mobile Keyboards
outcome: Show appropriate keyboard for input type
recommendation: Use inputmode attribute

name: Loading Indicators
outcome: Loading feedback should match the expected wait and avoid flashing for near-instant work
recommendation: Follow platform and component guidance; preserve layout focus and accessible busy status
avoid: Apply one timing threshold to every operation or leave long waits unexplained

name: Empty States
outcome: Guide users when no content exists
recommendation: Show helpful message and action

name: Error Recovery
outcome: Help users recover from errors
recommendation: Provide clear next steps

name: Progress Indicators
outcome: Show progress for multi-step processes
recommendation: Step indicators or progress bar

name: Confirmation Messages
outcome: Confirm successful actions
recommendation: Brief success message
